assess.note: Scores 4 groups from a plain-language questionnaire; not validated on lay-reported answers.

explanation.note: Included in /assess. Exact for the logistic-regression model.

family_history_insight.note: Descriptive counts from the real dataset + the answer's effect in the model + a descriptive summary of the relatives the user reports (no percentages).

safety_routing.note: Separate red-flag questions; any 'yes' returns an urgent-review notice that the model score cannot override.

model_comparison.note: LogReg vs RandomForest vs XGBoost vs baseline on real data.

eczema_subtypes.note: Only 'seborrheic dermatitis' and 'chronic dermatitis' exist as labels. Atopic, contact and dyshidrotic eczema: no data.

psoriasis_subtypes.note: No dataset with plaque/guttate/scalp/nail labels was obtained.

vitiligo.note: No real vitiligo dataset reachable; vitiligo is absent from the UCI data.

hereditary_risk_model.note: No real family-history cohort available. Only a descriptive family-history fact is provided.

genetic_risk.note: Needs individual genotypes and verified GWAS data; none were obtained.
